title: Cleartrip eyes sustained growth driven by air travel, non-air business
description:
Online travel technology platform Cleartrip expects to sustain its growth momentum in 2027, driven by steady expansion in air travel and a rising contribution from non-air businesses, according to a top executive of the company.
"The growth rate doubled year-on-year in 2026 and we expect to maintain similar momentum this year while aiming for a stronger business mix. The share of non-air business, including hotels, buses, trains and holiday packages, is expected to increase and there will be steady growth in air business as well," Cleartrip chief growth and business officer Manjari Singhal told PTI.
She said Cleartrip's performance is growing 8-10 times faster than the industry in air travel and the non-air share has risen to 27 per cent and the company is targeting around 40 per cent by the end of 2027, she added.
In the first half of this year (January-June), Flipkart-owned Cleartrip witnessed 40 per cent overall year-on-year growth, she said.
